UAE Hydrogen Strategy Announced

By Test Reporter, 15 March 2026

The UAE government announced a major hydrogen strategy this week. The plan includes investments in green hydrogen production and export infrastructure across multiple emirates.

Officials cited the country's solar resources as the foundation for low-cost hydrogen production via electrolysis. Production targets reach one million tonnes per year by 2031.

Industry analysts welcomed the move as a strong signal for the emerging hydrogen export market in the Gulf region.
